css: html,body{width:100%;height:100%;margin:0}.dashboard{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;height:150px;padding:8px 12px;display:grid;grid-template-rows:18px 38px 42px 18px;gap:6px}header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}header strong{font-size:13px;line-height:18px}header small{font-size:11px;line-height:18px}.stages{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}.stages li{border-top:4px solid var(--studio-border);padding:3px 6px 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;font-size:11px;line-height:14px;color:var(--studio-muted)}.stages li span{font-size:10px;line-height:13px}.stages .done{border-color:#7bbba4;color:var(--studio-text)}.stages .active{border-color:var(--studio-accent);color:var(--studio-text);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#a399ff18,transparent)}.metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}.metric{border:1px solid var(--studio-border);border-radius:var(--studio-radius);background:var(--studio-surface);padding:5px 10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.metric b{font-size:24px;font-weight:600;line-height:28px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.metric span{font-size:11px;line-height:14px;color:var(--studio-muted)}.issue{border-color:#d6a27066}.issue b{color:#e4b889}footer{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:11px;line-height:18px;color:var(--studio-muted)}.status-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#e4b889;flex:none}@media(max-width:400px){.dashboard{padding-inline:8px}.metrics{gap:5px}.metric{padding-inline:6px;gap:6px}.metric span{font-size:10px}}
